note: [L] runs the argument on a momentum-space matrix `V` with the `Signature` symmetries and subtracts `probe₂ V a` times a kinetic `W` normalized by `probe₂ W a = 1`, rather than alpha_{N,m} times the kinetic kernel; that `V` is the quadratic kernel of T is established elsewhere.

lemma relative_four {a : G.ColorIndex} (hG : G.Simple) (hw : Signature G true W) (hu : ContDiffAt ℂ ω W 0)
    (hα : probe₂ W a = 1) : Short (fun p => V p - (probe₂ V a) • W p) 4 := by
  have h' := h.sub (hw.smul (probe₂ V a).re)
  rw [h.probe_real hd] at h'
  have hd' := hd.sub (hu.const_smul (probe₂ V a))
  apply h'.short_four_of_short_three hd'; apply h'.short_three hd' hG (a:=a)
  unfold probe₂ at *; rw [mark_sub hd (hu.const_smul _),mark_smul,Matrix.sub_apply,Matrix.smul_apply,smul_eq_mul]
  linear_combination -(mark V 2 (unitAxis 0) (1,a) (1,a) / 2) * hα

proof_context.conclusion: `relative_four` shows that `V - probe₂ V a • W` has `Short _ 4`, vanishing to order four, once `W` has `probe₂ W a = 1`.

lemma Signature.color_scalar (h : Signature G b V) (hG : G.Simple) {p : Momentum} (hp : star p = p) (i j : Axis) :
    ∃ c : ℂ, ∀ a b, V p (i,a) (j,b) = if a=b then c else 0 := by
  let J (i : Axis) := (paint G Axis).symm.toLinearMap.comp (LinearMap.single ℝ (fun _ => G.Color) i)
  let K (i : Axis) := ((Complex.ofRealAm.toLinearMap.compLeft _).comp (J i))
  let S := Matrix.toLinearMap₂' ℂ (S₁:=ℂ) (S₂:=ℂ) (V p)
  let T := LinearMap.mk₂ ℝ (fun (x y : G.Color) => S (K i x) (K j y))
      (fun _ _ _ => by simp) (fun _ _ _ => by simp) (fun _ _ _ => by simp) (fun _ _ _ => by simp)
  have he v (a : Axis) (x : G.Color) : K a (G.adjoint v x) = fiberColor G v *ᵥ K a x := by
    change cvec (J _ _) = fiberColor G v *ᵥ cvec _
    rw [fiberColor,cmat_mulVec]
    congr 1; apply (paint G Axis).injective; ext1 b
    rw [paint_adjoints]
    change paint G Axis ((paint G Axis).symm _) _ = G.adjoint _ (paint G Axis ((paint G Axis).symm _) _)
    rw [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply,LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
    by_cases hb : b=a <;> simp [*, LinearMap.single_apply]
  obtain ⟨z,hz⟩ := scalar_complex hG T (fun u x y => by
    change S _ _ = S _ _; unfold S; rw [he,he, Matrix.toLinearMap₂'_apply',Matrix.toLinearMap₂'_apply']
    conv_rhs => rw [← h.color p hp u,← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec,← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec, Matrix.vecMul_transpose])
  let e := EuclideanSpace.basisFun G.ColorIndex ℝ
  have hb (i : Axis) a : K i (e a) = Pi.single (i,a) 1 := by
    ext1 ⟨k,l⟩; change Complex.ofReal ((Pi.single i (e a) : Axis → G.Color) k l) = _
    by_cases h : k=i <;> by_cases h' : l=a <;> simp [*, e]
  refine ⟨z,fun a b => ?_⟩
  have he := hz (e a) (e b)
  change S (K i _) (K j _) = _ at he
  unfold S at he
  rw [hb,hb, Matrix.toLinearMap₂'_apply', Matrix.mulVec_single_one,single_dotProduct,one_mul] at he
  split
  next h => simpa only [h,e.inner_eq_one,ofReal_one,mul_one,Matrix.col_apply] using he
  next h => simpa only [e.orthonormal.2 h,ofReal_zero,mul_zero,Matrix.col_apply] using he

proof_context.conclusion: For a simple gauge group the colour block of `V p` is scalar, `V p (i,a) (j,b) = if a=b then c else 0`.

lemma mark_pair₂ {a : G.ColorIndex} (hG : G.Simple) (hα : probe₂ V a = 0) {l k : Axis} (hlk : l≠k) : mark V 2 (unitAxis l + unitAxis k) = 0 := by
  let p := unitAxis l + unitAxis k
  have hm := h.mark_axis₂ hd hG hα
  have hS := h.short_two hd
  have hdia (i j : Axes G) (he : i.1=j.1) : mark V 2 p i j = 0 := by
    let s := Signed.mirror l
    have hs := h.mark_spin hd hS s (Or.inl rfl) p i j
    simp only [p,Signed.act_add,s,unit_act,Signed.mirror,Equiv.refl_apply,hlk, Prod.mk.eta,decide_eq_true_eq, ite_true, ite_false,neg_smul,one_smul] at hs
    rw [he] at hs
    have ht : mark V 2 (-unitAxis l + unitAxis k) i j = mark V 2 p i j := hs.trans (by split <;> simp [p])
    have hv := mark_cross hd (unitAxis l) (unitAxis k); rw [hm,hm,zero_add,smul_zero] at hv
    have hv' : mark V 2 p i j + mark V 2 (-unitAxis l + unitAxis k) i j = 0 := congr_fun (congr_fun hv i) j
    rw [ht] at hv'; linear_combination hv' / 2
  have hoff (i j : Axes G) (ha : i.1≠l) (hb : i.1≠k) (hc : i.1≠j.1) : mark V 2 p i j = 0 := by
    have hv := h.mark_spin hd hS (Signed.mirror i.1) (Or.inl rfl) p i j
    simp only [p,Signed.act_add,unit_act,Signed.mirror,Equiv.refl_apply,ha,hb,hc,Prod.mk.eta,decide_eq_true_eq, ite_true, ite_false,one_smul,neg_mul,one_mul] at hv
    dsimp [p]; linear_combination hv / 2
  ext ⟨i,b⟩ ⟨j,c⟩; change mark V 2 p (i,b) (j,c) = 0
  by_cases h₁ : i=j
  · exact hdia _ _ h₁
  by_cases hi : i=l ∨ i=k
  swap
  · exact hoff _ _ (fun h => hi (Or.inl h)) (fun h => hi (Or.inr h)) h₁
  by_cases hj : j=l ∨ j=k
  swap
  · have hv := h.mark_symmetry hd p 2
    rw [mark_neg,neg_sq,one_pow,one_smul] at hv
    rw [← hv,transpose_apply]; exact hoff _ _ (fun h => hj (Or.inl h)) (fun h => hj (Or.inr h)) (Ne.symm h₁)
  have ht : mark V 2 p (i,b) (l,c) + mark V 2 p (i,b) (k,c) = 0 := h.atSum hd hS (i,b) (l,c) k
  rcases hi with rfl|rfl <;> rcases hj with rfl|rfl
  · exact (h₁ rfl).elim
  · rwa [hdia (i,b) (i,c) rfl,zero_add] at ht
  · rwa [hdia (i,b) (i,c) rfl,add_zero] at ht
  exact (h₁ rfl).elim

proof_context.conclusion: Mirror reflections (`mark_spin` with `Signed.mirror`) kill the degree-two coefficient on `unitAxis l + unitAxis k` for `l ≠ k`.

lemma short_four_of_short_three (hs : Short V 3) : Short V 4 := by
  apply hs.succ; intro p; ext i j; change _ = 0
  let s : Signed := ⟨Equiv.refl _,fun _ => true⟩
  have he := h.mark_spin hd hs s (Or.inl rfl) p i j
  rw [show s.act p = -p from rfl,mark_neg] at he
  simp [s] at he; linear_combination -he / 2

proof_context.conclusion: Reflection through the origin (`s` flipping every axis) removes degree four once degrees up to three vanish, using `mark_neg`.
